text: And Jehovah{H3068} spake{H1696} unto Moses,{H4872} saying,{H559}

Command{H6680} the children{H1121} of Israel,{H3478} and say{H559} unto them, My oblation,{H7133} my food for my offerings{H7133} made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto me, shall ye observe{H8104} to offer{H7126} unto me in their due season.{H4150}

And thou shalt say{H559} unto them, This is the offering made by fire{H801} which ye shall offer{H7126} unto Jehovah:{H3068} he-lambs{H3532} a{H1121} year{H8141} old without blemish,{H8549} two{H8147} day by day,{H3117} for a continual{H8548} burnt-offering.{H5930}
The one{H259} lamb{H3532} shalt thou offer{H6213} in the morning,{H1242} and the other{H8145} lamb{H3532} shalt thou offer{H6213} at even;{H6153}
and the tenth{H6224} part of an ephah{H374} of fine flour{H5560} for a meal-offering,{H4503} mingled{H1101} with the fourth{H7243} part of a hin{H1969} of beaten{H3795} oil.{H8081}
It is a continual{H8548} burnt-offering,{H5930} which was ordained{H6213} in mount{H2022} Sinai{H5514} for a sweet{H5207} savor,{H7381} an offering made by fire{H801} unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And the drink-offering{H5262} thereof shall be the fourth{H7243} part of a hin{H1969} for the one{H259} lamb:{H3532} in the holy{H6944} place shalt thou pour{H5258} out a drink-offering{H5262} of strong drink{H7941} unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And the other{H8145} lamb{H3532} shalt thou offer{H6213} at even:{H6153} as the meal-offering{H4503} of the morning,{H1242} and as the drink-offering{H4503} thereof, thou shalt offer{H6213} it, an offering made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And on the sabbath{H7676} day{H3117} two{H8147} he-lambs{H3532} a{H1121} year{H8141} old without blemish,{H8549} and two{H8147} tenth{H6241} parts [of an ephah] of fine flour{H5560} for a meal-offering,{H4503} mingled{H1101} with oil,{H8081} and the drink-offering{H5262} thereof:
this is the burnt-offering{H5930} of every sabbath,{H7676} besides the continual{H8548} burnt-offering,{H5930} and the drink-offering{H5930} thereof.

And in the beginnings{H7218} of your months{H2320} ye shall offer{H7126} a burnt-offering{H5930} unto Jehovah:{H3068} two{H8147} young{H1241} bullocks,{H6499} and one{H259} ram,{H352} seven{H7651} he-lambs{H3532} a{H1121} year{H8141} old without blemish;{H8549}

and three{H7969} tenth parts [of an ephah]{H6241} of fine flour{H5560} for a meal-offering,{H4503} mingled{H1101} with oil,{H8081} for each{H259} bullock;{H6499} and two{H8147} tenth{H6241} parts of fine flour{H5560} for a meal-offering,{H4503} mingled{H1101} with oil,{H8081} for the one{H259} ram;{H352}

and a tenth part{H6241} of fine flour{H5560} mingled{H1101} with oil{H8081} for a meal-offering{H4503} unto every{H259} lamb;{H3532} for a burnt-offering{H4503} of a sweet{H5207} savor,{H7381} an offering made by fire{H801} unto Jehovah.{H3068}

And their drink-offerings{H5262} shall be half{H2677} a hin{H1969} of wine{H3196} for a bullock,{H6499} and the third{H7992} part of a hin{H1969} for the ram,{H352} and the fourth{H7243} part of a hin{H1969} for a lamb:{H3532} this is the burnt-offering{H5930} of every month{H2320} throughout the months{H2320} of the year.{H8141}

And one{H259} he -{H8163} goat{H5795} for a sin-offering{H2403} unto Jehovah;{H3068} it shall be offered{H6213} besides the continual{H8548} burnt-offering,{H5930} and the drink-offering{H5930} thereof.
And in the first{H7223} month,{H2320} on the fourteenth{H702} day{H3117} of the month,{H2320} is Jehovah's passover.{H6453}
And on the fifteenth{H2568} day{H3117} of this month{H2320} shall be a feast:{H2282} seven{H7651} days{H3117} shall unleavened bread{H4682} be eaten.{H398}
In the first{H7223} day{H3117} shall be a holy{H6944} convocation:{H4744} ye shall do{H6213} no servile{H5656} work;{H4399}

but ye shall offer{H7126} an offering made by fire,{H801} a burnt-offering{H5930} unto Jehovah:{H3068} two{H8147} young{H1241} bullocks,{H6499} and one{H259} ram,{H352} and seven{H7651} he-lambs{H3532} a{H1121} year{H8141} old; they shall be unto you without blemish;{H8549}

and their meal-offering,{H4503} fine flour{H5560} mingled{H1101} with oil:{H8081} three{H7969} tenth parts{H6241} shall ye offer{H6213} for a bullock,{H6499} and two{H8147} tenth parts{H6241} for the ram;{H352}
a tenth part{H6241} shalt thou offer{H6213} for every{H259} lamb{H3532} of the seven{H7651} lambs;{H3532}
and one{H259} he-goat{H8163} for a sin-offering,{H2403} to make atonement{H3722} for you.
Ye shall offer{H6213} these besides the burnt-offering{H5930} of the morning,{H1242} which is for a continual{H8548} burnt-offering.{H5930}

After this manner ye shall offer{H6213} daily,{H3117} for seven{H7651} days,{H3117} the food{H3899} of the offering made by fire,{H801} of a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah:{H3068} it shall be offered{H6213} besides the continual{H8548} burnt-offering,{H5930} and the drink-offering{H5930} thereof.
And on the seventh{H7637} day{H3117} ye shall have a holy{H6944} convocation:{H4744} ye shall do{H6213} no servile{H5656} work.{H4399}

Also in the day{H3117} of the first-fruits,{H1061} when ye offer{H7126} a new{H2319} meal-offering{H4503} unto Jehovah{H3068} in your [feast of] weeks,{H7620} ye shall have a holy{H6944} convocation;{H4744} ye shall do{H6213} no servile{H5656} work;{H4399}

but ye shall offer{H7126} a burnt-offering{H5930} for a sweet{H5207} savor{H7381} unto Jehovah:{H3068} two{H8147} young{H1241} bullocks,{H6499} one{H259} ram,{H352} seven{H7651} he-lambs{H3532} a{H1121} year{H8141} old;

and their meal-offering,{H4503} fine flour{H5560} mingled{H1101} with oil,{H8081} three{H7969} tenth parts{H6241} for each{H259} bullock,{H6499} two{H8147} tenth parts{H6241} for the one{H259} ram,{H352}
a tenth part{H6241} for every{H259} lamb{H3532} of the seven{H7651} lambs;{H3532}
one{H259} he-goat,{H5795} to make atonement{H3722} for you.
Besides the continual{H8548} burnt-offering,{H5930} and the meal-offering{H4503} thereof, ye shall offer{H6213} them (they shall be unto you without blemish),{H8549} and their drink-offerings.{H5262}
